prompt.project_info: Candid pool-club resort lounge portrait with polished smartphone lifestyle styling.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with long platinum-blonde hair, fair warm-tan skin, defined jawline, high cheekbones and calm neutral gaze looking camera-left, wearing a black long-sleeved matte bodycon mini dress and black pointed-toe rhinestone heels.
prompt.composition_elements: Low-angle 9:16 poolside lounge candid from near the foot of a pink-and-white striped sunbed. Recline sideways into the cushion, torso supported, one knee gently bent, legs extending toward camera, right hand holding a clear pink drink with two thin straws and left arm along the seat edge. Place a pink quilted top-handle handbag in the foreground and preserve its supplied logo/mark exactly.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft late-afternoon or early-evening natural light with warm highlights, gentle shadows, bright umbrellas and cabanas, greenery and slightly softened distant background.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 17 Pro 1x main-camera feel, stable handheld micro-tilt, mild wide perspective, face and drink sharp, foreground bag and shoes sharp, background softly detailed, natural colors.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic candid pool-club resort lounge portrait in 9:16 format of one original approved adult woman with long platinum-blonde hair, fair warm-tan skin, defined jawline, high cheekbones and a calm neutral gaze looking camera-left. She wears a black long-sleeved matte bodycon mini dress and black pointed-toe heels with rhinestone texture and thin ankle straps. Recline her sideways on a pink-and-white vertically striped cushioned sunbed, torso supported by pillows, one knee gently bent and legs extending toward the camera. Her right hand holds a clear short glass with ice, a pale pink drink and two thin straws; her left arm rests along the seat edge. Place a pink quilted top-handle handbag with its supplied logo or mark in the foreground. Use a low angle from the foot end, soft late-afternoon or early-evening natural light, warm highlights, gentle shadows, white umbrellas and cabanas, greenery, distant chairs and a slightly softened background. Use an iPhone 17 Pro 1x main-camera feel, stable handheld micro-tilt, mild wide perspective, sharp face, drink, foreground bag and shoes, natural colors and polished candid lifestyle finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, nudity, child, teen, body-part emphasis, fetish framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, altered supplied logo, unreadable text
